label: Pultost
note: Spreadable (Loiten) and grainy (Hedemark, Lillehammer) types; stronger when aged

about.text: Pultost is a soft, mature Norwegian sour milk cheese flavoured with caraway. It is made from soured skimmed milk, salted, and is acid-set and very low in fat; it is spread on bread or flatbread or eaten with boiled potatoes.

how.label: cook the curd, crumble, ferment, salt
how.text: After the skim-milk curd is cooked and drained, it is crumbled and left to heat itself with yeasts before salt and caraway go in. No culture species is named in any source.

steps.note: At nearly 60 °C the curd hardens into a raft.
The crumbled curd is piled in a wooden trough and smells of yeast (acetone, banana) as it warms itself to about 34 °C in a 15 °C room.

processing.text: No culture species is named. The crumbled curd is piled in a wooden trough and warms itself to about 34 °C in a 15 °C room; farm versions ripen up to about a year.
